name: IRAPH SUI
positioning: IRAPH SUI, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Miyako Okinawa: a beachfront resort on Irabu Island in Miyakojima, with sea-view rooms and suites, some with private pools
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a private pool and terrace
Travelers bringing a dog, with dog-friendly rooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel is a beachfront resort on Irabu Island, part of Miyakojima in Okinawa; Irabu Island lies southwest of Okinawa.
The hotel is surrounded by forests, the sea and the culture of Miyakojima City.
Guest rooms and suites feature balconies or terraces and sea views.
All accommodations feature a private terrace or a garden.
Rooms offer views of white sand and blue sea.
Suites with outdoor pools and a spacious terrace are suited to romantic getaways.
The spa offers couples massages, facials, a foot bath and in-suite massages.
The restaurant serves dishes featuring wagyu, pork, fresh fish and vegetables.
The hotel has a lobby bar.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
The closest airport is Shimojishima Airport.
Self parking and valet parking are complimentary.

highlights.text: Some rooms have a garden with Okinawan botanicals, a terrace and a private swimming pool.
Select accommodations offer private pools and whirlpools.
The SUI Spa offers treatments that incorporate the sand, sun and waters of Miyakojima and Okinawa.
TIN'IN is the hotel's French restaurant, with indoor and outdoor terraces looking at the blue sea and sunsets.
Guests can bring a pet and stay in a dog-friendly room or suite.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is seasonal, open March to November.
Rooms do not have a work space.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires connecting flights.
